subject: Consolidated console + API onboarding — request to swap session dates
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@acme-tech.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acme-tech.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Request: combine console + API sessions, and move dates

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — we are excited to get the team up to speed. We signed up for two separate sessions (console walkthrough on Aug 25, API enablement on Aug 27), but after syncing with engineering wed like to:  

- Combine the sessions into a single two-part day (morning: console walkthrough; afternoon: API deep-dive + hands-on)
- Move the combined day up to Aug 24 if possible (several engineers are OOO the 27th)

Are those options feasible? If combining is tricky, wed be fine swapping the current dates so engineering can attend the API slot. We also attached the draft internal agenda so you can see what we want to cover.

Appreciate the flexibility — Elena

Attachment: session-agenda-acme-2026-08-25.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@acme-tech.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acme-tech.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: combine console + API sessions, and move dates

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the agenda. Short answer: yes, we can do a combined day and we have two options depending on your goals:  

Option A (preferred): Aug 24, 09:30-16:00 PT — two-part day with a 60-minute lunch break. Morning: Console walkthrough + RBAC/examples. Afternoon: API enablement + live key exchange and a short hands-on lab.

Option B: Keep two separate half-days but swap the dates so API is Aug 24 (so your engineers can join) and console remains Aug 25.

Ive looped in Dev (will run the API lab) and Grace (CSM; will co-present the console content and own follow-ups). Can Dev/G say if Aug 24 works on your side?

Ill hold a tentative calendar invite for Option A (Aug 24) and we can finalize once we hear back.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: combine console + API sessions, and move dates

Hi all — Aug 24 works for me. Ill prepare an API lab that covers: token management, model pinning, request patterns for low-latency vs high-throughput, and a short troubleshooting checklist. Estimated hands-on time: 60 minutes.

Quick logistical notes:
- Can you confirm the engineers will have Admin API keys (or I can provision short-lived tokens during the session)?
- If you want to exercise dedicated/private routing later, we can include a short demo but wont do the private deployment work during onboarding.

If Aug 24 is confirmed Ill add a short section in the shared agenda with the lab steps and a GitHub gist with example curl/python snippets.

— Dev

PS: I uploaded a proposed lab gist to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ACME-ONBOARD-2026
